While returning from Goreme, Cappadocia, to Istanbul, I visited another destination called Afyonkarahisar. I visited places like Ayazini, Phrigiyan Valley, Aydalaz Castle, Sultan Divani Mevlevihanesi Museum, and Taşhan in Afyonkarahisar. Watch this video to learn more about the place and my experience.
